verses.text: A song of ascents. When I was in trouble, I cried out to the LORD, and he answered me.
LORD, rescue me from lying lips and a tongue that tricks people.
What are you going to get for this? What more will be done to you, you lying tongue?
Sharp arrows from a mighty warrior, along with glowing coals from a juniper.
How miserable for me to live in Meshech, to stay among the tents of Kedar!
I’ve lived too long beside people who hate peace.
I’m all for peace, but the minute I speak up, they’re ready for war.
